paragraphs.text: My Cozy DSH: an illustrated theme for DeepSeek Harness
Transform your DSH workspace into a cozy, illustrated room with warm colors, a glowing desk lamp, le
afy plants, and playful pets. Adjust the lighting, start a new session with a sleeping Westie, and k
eep a friendly orange cat by your side while you work.
Install the repository as a bundle using DeepSeek Harness's plugin manager. The package name is `@lo
cal/desk-scene-ui`; the bundle patch enables the matching client plugin. Restart the app after insta
; the bundle patch enables the matching client plugin. Restart the app after installation if needed.
This release contains the prebuilt client, its host entry point, bundle patch, icon, and English and
Chinese locale files. Build sources are not included.
